title: feat(desktop): add a Record submenu to the tray menu
body:
## What changed

The tray's right-click menu now follows "Kaipu Record Modes v2", section 5.

- Idle: Open Kaipu Record, Record (Record screen, Record area, Record window...), Take screenshot, Library, Settings..., Quit.
- While recording or paused: Stop recording appears right after Record; the three Record items are disabled. Pause keeps Stop enabled.
- Left click still toggles the capture panel. Locale change still rebuilds the menu. Tray icon logic is untouched.

How:
- New `main/tray-menu.ts`: a pure template builder, testable without Electron.
- `tray.ts` builds the menu from main's translator and rebuilds it on locale change and on recording state change.
- `recording-hub.ts`: `registerRecordingHub` takes an optional `onActivityChange` callback, called from `broadcastActivity`; `index.ts` uses it to call `setTrayRecording`.
- i18n: new `tray.*` keys in en and es.
- Docs: `backlog/tray-record-submenu.md` (Ready to validate), backlog index row and sidebar entry.

## Decisions and deviations

- Accelerators are display-only (`registerAccelerator: false`), taken from the configured shortcuts (`startRecording`, `recordArea`, `stopRecording`, `captureScreenshot`). "Open" shows `CommandOrControl+O`, also display-only.
- "Record window..." reuses the capture panel's "Change" path: it opens the Record page with the source picker. Main has no trigger for a window-only thumbnail picker.
- Library and Settings: main has no navigation channel to the renderer, so it sets the main window's URL hash (the renderer uses a hash router). A recreated window gets the hash after `did-finish-load`.
- "Highlighted" Stop is not possible on a native menu; it is just the extra item.
- No renderer, overlay, capture panel or Record page files were touched.

## How to verify manually (not yet done)

1. macOS and Windows: right-click the tray idle and check the items and shown shortcuts.
2. Start a recording, right-click: Stop present, Record items grey. Pause and resume: Stop stays enabled. Stop from the menu.
3. Change the language in Settings, right-click: labels follow.
4. Library and Settings from the tray with the main window open, hidden, and closed.
5. Record screen / Record area / Record window... / Take screenshot each do what their shortcut does.

## Not verified

- Nothing was run in a real Electron session or on Windows. Native menu rendering, accelerator display and the hash navigation are untested at runtime.
- Checks run: `bun run test` in apps/kaipu-record (270 files, 2378 tests pass), `check-types`, lint (0 errors), pre-push `verify:local` passes.
